case: P01 OpenAI × Responses models listed by ADR-0018
source: Synthetic offline fixture (issue 34). Expected requests follow pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-responses.ts buildParams and openai-responses-shared.ts convertResponsesMessages with the models' frozen openai.json data, except for the optional additional_tools/tool search features barness does not implement, which follow pi's resolveTranscriptTools with them off; the differences are ledger extensions (ADR-0018 决策四). Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen tiered prices. Checked against frozen pi by the differential.

scenarios.about: A tool round trip with the initial tools; input above the 272000-token tier threshold, so usage is priced at the tier's rates.
A later system message only adds convert: it goes in place (supportsMidConvoSystemMessages) and the request declares the current tools (lookup, convert).
A later system message removes clock and adds convert, a change no addition-only transport can replay: the request declares the current tools (lookup, convert).
